title: Tiempos de paso 42K Valencia 2026 — official per-kilometre split PDF
claims: The official split-time PDF lists per-kilometre road names from km 0 Puente de Monteolivete to km 42 Ciudad de las Artes y las Ciencias, with the finish at Lago CACSA frente Hemisfèric.
The half-marathon point (M.M./HM) is marked at km 21, Calle de la Reina.

The PDF provides two reference split clocks per kilometre, labelled DESDE/FROM and HASTA/TO, spanning the fastest and slowest wave pacing windows; these are reference clocks, not published cut-off times.
The PDF header lists nine start times: 8:15, 8:25, 8:35, 8:45, 8:55, 9:05, 9:15, 9:25 and 9:35.

verification.checkedVia: 下载官方 PDF（117,835 字节）并逐页读图核对公里点、街名与两列时钟
verification.note: PDF 一页，表头 06.12.26；FROM/TO 两列分别对应快慢波次参考时刻。
